verses.text: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
lines: Better is a dry morsel with quietness,
than a house full of feasting with strife.

verses.text: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.
lines: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame,
and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.

verses.text: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.
lines: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold,
but Yahweh tests the hearts.

verses.text: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
lines: An evildoer heeds wicked lips.
A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

verses.text: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
lines: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker.
He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

verses.text: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children are their parents.
lines: Children’s children are the crown of old men;
the glory of children are their parents.

verses.text: Arrogant speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.
lines: Arrogant speech isn’t fitting for a fool,
much less do lying lips fit a prince.

verses.text: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.
lines: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it;
wherever he turns, he prospers.

verses.text: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
lines: He who covers an offense promotes love;
but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.

verses.text: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
lines: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding
than a hundred lashes into a fool.

verses.text: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
lines: An evil man seeks only rebellion;
therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

verses.text: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
lines: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man,
rather than a fool in his folly.

verses.text: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
lines: Whoever rewards evil for good,
evil shall not depart from his house.

verses.text: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.
lines: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam,
therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

verses.text: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
lines: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous,
both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

verses.text: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
lines: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom,
since he has no understanding?

verses.text: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
lines: A friend loves at all times;
and a brother is born for adversity.

verses.text: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
lines: A man void of understanding strikes hands,
and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.

verses.text: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.
lines: He who loves disobedience loves strife.
One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.

verses.text: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.
lines: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity,
and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.

verses.text: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.
lines: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves.
The father of a fool has no joy.

verses.text: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
lines: A cheerful heart makes good medicine,
but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

verses.text: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
lines: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret,
to pervert the ways of justice.

verses.text: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
lines: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding,
but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.

verses.text: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
lines: A foolish son brings grief to his father,
and bitterness to her who bore him.

verses.text: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.
lines: Also to punish the righteous is not good,
nor to flog officials for their integrity.

verses.text: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
lines: He who spares his words has knowledge.
He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.

verses.text: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
lines: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise.
When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
